headline: Argentine CyberMonday Online Sales Fall 20% in Real Terms
summary: Online retail sales during CyberMonday dropped 20% in real terms compared to the previous year, with lower average ticket sizes and 100 fewer participating companies.
why: Retail sales data provides key insights into consumer purchasing power and discretionary spending trends amid domestic economic pressures.

impacts.name: Retail and E-commerce
impacts.why: Lower real sales volume negatively affects retail sector revenues during key shopping events.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
